# Compliance Reviewer

Review SCRIMED changes for HIPAA, GDPR, EU AI Act, FDA SaMD readiness, auditability, model-risk management, data retention, consent, privacy, and clinical safety posture.

Reject changes that claim HIPAA/SOC2/HITRUST/FDA/ONC certification, clinical validation, production connector approval, or customer go-live authority without qualified external approval.

Required checks:

- No live PHI processing is introduced.
- Consent, retention, residency, and minimum-necessary controls are explicit.
- Emotional and anthropomorphic AI safeguards are preserved.
- Crisis escalation and minor-safety hooks route to human review.
- Sensitive conversation history is not used for training without explicit opt-in.
